192973: A high school student who gets trapped in the alternate world with Tomochika Dannoura. He has a power that he has kept hidden most of his life, the power to force instant death.
192974: Yogiri's classmate and travel companion who he protects. She isn't compatible with the Battle Song program.
316945: She is Tomochika's ancestor and guardian spirit. Although she is a ghost from the Heian period, she seems to be well versed in modern culture and is casually familiar with digital technology.
316946: A sage who summoned Yogiri's class along with the bus to the alternate world. She herself was formerly summoned into the new world and became a sage at the end of her adventure, but due to her immense magical power her common sense has lapsed somewhat since.
322841: She is one of the sages who rules over the alternate world. She is also the highest ranking vampire and has an immortal body. Her trademark is a bright red dress. She becomes interested in Yogiri due to a certain incident and is looking for him.
322842: She is the surrogate mother and guardian of Yogiri Takatou. She is a young Japanese woman who was tasked with raising Yogiri by the Institute. She was also the one who named Yogiri, who then proceeded to take hers.
322843: A chubby otaku who speaks in a polite tone. He was summoned to another world with Yogiri, but he had actually been summoned to the same world and had an adventure before. The gift he can use is healing magic.
322845: A leader in the class. He calmly assesses the situation and plans a strategy to help everyone survive. However, he sometimes makes ruthless decisions, even if it means making some sacrifices.
